entries.name: Double Fire Doctrine
entries.text: Unit-unique: unlocks Double Fire, can't combine with Focus Fire, 45s CD, +12% rate of fire, +1 shot to spell (6->7 arrows). Mandatory per Amya. OP note: "confirm exact name."

entries.name: Bolt Penetration Doctrine
entries.text: Huge per Amya: +1 additional target penetration on top of baseline Penetrating Shots. Mandatory per Amya. OP note: "confirm exact name."

entries.name: Unit Damage Doctrine V
entries.text: +120 unit DMG, +80 all-type. Mandatory per Amya.

entries.name: Ammo Doctrine
entries.text: +35% ammo, +140 piercing AP. OP notes screenshot stat differs from ConqHub's 'New Ammo IV +120 AP'. Top pick.

entries.name: Accuracy Doctrine
entries.text: +40% shooting accuracy, +80 piercing DMG. Top pick.

entries.name: Epic Crossbow II
entries.text: +50 piercing DMG, +200 piercing pen; alt if no Ammo doctrine or no Unit DMG V. Top pick.

doctrines.note: Veterancy: Top Line (do NOT take the last node), rest Bot Line. Hero pairing: not specified in this thread. MEGA mandatory per OP (verbatim emphasis): either Double Fire + ROF doctrine OR basic ROF -- either way adds +1 shot to the spell (6->7 arrows). Bolt Penetration is also huge. Accuracy and Ammo are not strictly required, can be replaced by Hero DMG (pen) or any piercing DMG increase. Playstyle: huge damage drop-off -- need to be near the fights to have actual impact (press 2 can have good range); never overlap their spell with Double Shot, do one then the other. No dedicated Tips & Tricks section beyond the Playstyle notes (OP gap, not fabricated). 'Don't put' is a literal X placeholder in the OP. Combined-thread note: tierlist links both 'Demesne Arbalists' and 'Black Tortoise Regiment' to this thread, but the OP text only ever names Demesne Arbalists -- Black Tortoise Regiment guidance is not present in this thread's visible content, not asserted here. Demesne Arbalists is on the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch shortlist: "Piercing Bolts" target count 2->1 (Nerf); fire rate -16%. This build/usage was drafted from a guide edited 2026-05-27, before the patch anchor -- the doctrine emphasis on multi-target penetration ("Bolt Penetration Doctrine" / Double Fire multi-shot value) and the Playstyle notes assume the pre-patch 2-target Piercing Bolts; role guidance (line-clearing vs single-target) may need to shift per the shortlist rationale. fightRatings stays null/dataGap (no strength block in source) -- nothing to be stale there.
